==Summary==
'''Ashidaka-Uyll Mark XVI ''' is one of the [[Multi-tool|Multi-Tools]] in [[No Man's Sky]].

It is grey in color with white and purple stripes on the barrel, and light blue inside the trigger guard.

==Acquirement==
The Ashidaka-Uyll Mark XVI  is a 23-slot multi-tool offered for sale to player ''zerovalence '' for 167,400 [[units]].

Location is the [[HUB-G-E0 Gatsby]] [[star system]].
